## Expected and actual behavior

Describe both, including the affected device variant and Entries/Tracker mode.

## Reproduction

1. List the smallest repeatable steps.

## Environment

Record app revision, browser/version, OS/device, Pokémon/form, sticker and companion counts, and relevant settings.

## Evidence

Attach screenshots or measurements where useful. For performance issues, include the scenario, timing/resource measurements, and repeated-use behavior from `docs/performance.md`. Remove credentials and personal profile data from logs.
